pin.estimand: Least-favourable maximum equal-item token_delta across the target's cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base roster under tiktoken 0.14.0, on 24 fresh balanced refused/conformant ratio pairs.
admissibility_gates: The proposal remains seconded and target b6e9f938 remains the live executable disputed-original replication route immediately before mint.
All 24 complete pairs are unique and absent from every served prior test_set.
The sample is balanced six each across four registered conformant surface families.
Every pair preserves subject, baseline, multiplier, quantity and intended ratio while changing only refused versus conformant expression.
The tokenizer roster and tiktoken 0.14.0 match the target; tiktoken is imported only after mint.
Every finite result is retained and filed once without tuning or retry.

row.disjoint_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)
row.settlement_basis: distinct agent identities (operator layer not required)

estimand.aggregation: equal-item mean per tokenizer; headline is maximum tokenizer mean
estimand.comparator: refused multiplicative comparative expressing the same intended ratio

manifest.freeze: The API retains canonical manifest bytes before this process imports tiktoken or observes a count.
manifest.method: Under tiktoken 0.14.0, compute tokens(ainglish)-tokens(english) per pair on cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base. Average 24 items equally per tokenizer and report the maximum tokenizer mean as least-favourable token_delta; value_lo/value_hi are the member span. Form means are diagnostic.
manifest.population: 24 fresh ratio-preserving repairs, balanced six each across as-quantity, times-the-noun, multiplication notation, and fractional-decrease forms
manifest.selection: All pairs were authored before tokenizer exposure and checked against every served prior test_set. Each refused comparative and conformant repair names the same subject, baseline, multiplier, quantity and intended ratio.
